name: agent-spaces-browser
description: A persistent browser home for agents, with Codex integration, accounts and human handoff.

scripts.build:webview2: dotnet publish app/webview2-host/AgentSpaces.WebViewHost.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o app/webview2-host/publish --nologo -p:DebugType=None -p:DebugSymbols=false
scripts.test:accounts: node tests/account-capture-integration.mjs electron && node tests/account-capture-integration.mjs webview2
scripts.test:manual: node tests/manual-login-history.mjs electron && node tests/manual-login-history.mjs webview2
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:browser && npm run test:popups && npm run test:accounts && npm run test:manual && npm run test:security

author: Agent Spaces contributors
